title: Hilbert's Sixteenth Problem, Second Part
exact_target: How many isolated periodic motions can a planar polynomial differential equation have, and how can those cycles be arranged?

sources.citation: Luiz Fernando da Silva Gouveia and Joan Torregrosa, The local cyclicity problem. Melnikov method using Lyapunov constants, Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society 65 (2022), 356-375, Introduction, p. 356.
A note on a recent attempt to solve the second part of Hilbert's 16th Problem.
Pesquisadores da Unesp propõem solução para desafio matemático em aberto há mais de um século.
